history.summary: A 2019 463 sqft 1BR at Thomson Impressions asking $1,836 psf — verifiably at/below the most recent comparable (an identical 463 sqft unit sold $858,000 / $1,854 psf in Sep 2025) and well under the project's 12-month average of $2,046 psf. Sits ~5 min from Bright Hill MRT on the Thomson-East Coast Line in a healthy D20 location, with above-district rental yield (~3.6%). The standout of this batch.
history.rating_rationale: The cheapness is verified against real same-size transactions: a 463 sqft 1BR transacted at $858K ($1,854 psf) in Sep 2025, so the $849,888 / $1,835.61 psf asking is actually below the latest comparable and far below the project-wide 12-mo avg of $2,046 psf. Cohort depth is solid (psf_cohort_txns=12, appreciation_txns=91, psf_premium_vs_cohort -2.2%), so the -14.2% age-adj cheapness is robust, not a quirk. Dated physical catalyst: Bright Hill CR13 / Sin Ming TE7 on the TEL (~5 min walk), which materially improved connectivity post-2021. Rental yield ~3.6% beats the district average ~2.89%. D20 is an RCR/OCR district where v3.4 priors favor forward returns, and value-vs-peers (the strongest robust signal) is decisively met here.
red_flags: 99-year lease from ~2015 with 2019 completion — leasehold decay over the hold horizon (still ~88 years, minor)
Shoebox 1BR — resale buyer pool skews investor, more cyclical than family units
Entry near the top of the absolute psf range means upside is the verified discount, not headline momentum
catalysts: Bright Hill MRT (TEL) ~5 min walk — confirmed, operational connectivity catalyst
Below latest same-size comp ($1,854 psf) and well below project avg ($2,046 psf) — verified entry discount
Above-district rental yield (~3.6% vs ~2.89%) supports holding economics
